basis: The task requires routing to the highest-incidence state profile. The dashboard is a choropleth map where the legend indicates that dark red corresponds to the lowest values (Low, 0) and light yellow corresponds to the highest values (High, 100). Among the three options, Texas (TX) is colored light yellow, indicating it has the highest incidence rate compared to Washington (WA) and Colorado (CO), which are colored dark red (low incidence).
option_label: Open Texas (TX) incidence profile for follow-up routing
